bridgeRouteRisk.summary: syrupUSDT moves cross-chain via Chainlink CCIP using the Cross-Chain Token (CCT) standard: each chain (Ethereum canonical plus Plasma, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Base, Solana) hosts a native syrupUSDT token paired with a BurnMintTokenPool, so circulating supply is burned on the source and minted on the destination over CCIP's validated DON messaging with the Risk Management Network backstop. Maple adopted CCT for its Syrup tokens and a dedicated CCIP directory entry exists for syrupUSDT, explaining the different per-chain addresses (no lockbox/wrapped model).
